dse_runs.notes: Spec is named infeasible: needs >=400 MSPS single-lane with max_abs_err <= 2^-12, min LUTs. Prior campaigns suggest single-lane iterative CORDIC struggles at 400 MSPS; pipelined families with enough stages (m) and adequate data width for 12-bit accuracy are the likely feasible region. Explore pipelined_m and unrolled_k families broadly; keep data width high enough for 12-bit accuracy.

final_text: Campaign complete. The single spec `infeasible_dds_400msps` (wideband DDS, ≥400 MSPS single-lane, max error ≤ 2⁻¹², minimise LUTs) was taken down the full fidelity ladder: L1 spent the entire 400-evaluation budget across the structured DSE graph (200 evals, inner architect declared the spec infeasible), a pipelined_m study (100 evals, m=2..8, data width 12..24) and an unrolled_k study (100 evals, k=2..8) — all with zero feasible designs. L2 had nothing feasible to simulate, and L3/L4/L5 (via the ladder sub-agent) each reported no selection to verify, synthesize or back-annotate, with no winner change flagged, so no reexplore was needed. The spec was finalized with no design selected, consistent with its infeasibility.
